policy: Missing creator/licence/original/permission blocks the asset from any public pack (blueprint §16.1 [G]). Distinguishes between SYNTHETIC_DEV (blocks production gate), TTS_PRELIMINARY (pipeline verified speech), and FIELD_CLEARED_PRODUCTION / PUBLIC_DOMAIN_ARCHIVAL (editorial cleared).
target_pairs_specification: 3 comparison pairs across 3 distinct sites consisting of 6 images total (3 historic + 3 modern). Note: Photo 1003(49) is an alternate sequential historical phase for Mahabodhi, NOT a substitute for Nalanda or Rajgir.

three_site_asset_schedule.site_1_mahabodhi: Historical: J.D. Beglar 1880s photo (Primary plate: Photo 1003(50) during restoration; Sequential phase: Photo 1003(49) pre-repairs; Print alternative: Cunningham 1892 Mahabodhi Plate I / VIII); Modern: 1 new licensed photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0
three_site_asset_schedule.site_2_nalanda_temple_3: Historical: Dr. David B. Spooner 1915 ASI excavation plate XVI; Modern: 1 new licensed photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0
three_site_asset_schedule.site_3_rajgir_cyclopean_wall: Historical: Sir John Marshall 1906 ASI survey plate XXIX; Modern: 1 new licensed photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0
three_site_asset_schedule.total_images: 3 distinct sites, 3 historical images + 3 modern images = 6 image assets total

assets.reason: Device restrictions at the temple; search-only POI, no reference capture suggested on site.

historical.title: Mahabodhi Temple from South-East prior to and during Cunningham-Beglar restoration (Primary plate: Photo 1003(50) during restoration; Sequential phase: Photo 1003(49) before repairs)
historical.archive: British Library: India Office Select Materials / ASI Photographic Collection
historical.accession_id: BL Photo 1003(50) (primary plate: during restoration), Photo 1003(49) (sequential historical phase: before repairs; alternate Mahabodhi view, not a substitute for Nalanda or Rajgir) [formerly cited as Photo 1003/(1130)]; ASI Print Collection Vol. XIII, Item 42
historical.print_alternative_source: Alexander Cunningham 1892 ('Mahabodhi, or the Great Buddhist Temple under the Bodhi Tree at Buddha-Gaya', Plate I / VIII); Government of India official archaeological publication under Indian Copyright Act 1957 § 28 (term expired 1 Jan 1953), providing lawful public domain print reproduction resolving British Library Photo 1003(50) offline digital access restriction.

verified_shelfmarks.catalogue_note: British Library catalogue descriptions verify Photo 1003(50) (during restoration, primary plate) and Photo 1003(49) (before repairs, sequential phase for Mahabodhi, not a substitute for Nalanda or Rajgir) as related catalogue views; both digital files are currently listed as unavailable online, establishing provenance but not downloadability, and lawful reproduction files remain to be acquired
verified_shelfmarks.digital_image_availability: Digital images currently listed as unavailable online by British Library catalogue; establishes provenance, not downloadability or redistribution permission

historical.statutory_basis: Indian Copyright Act, 1957 § 22 (author life + 60 years expired 1 Jan 1968); § 28 (official publication 1892 expired 1 Jan 1953); legacy 1914 Act 50-year negative term expired 1934; UK Crown Copyright expired
historical.redistribution_permissions: Public domain under Indian Copyright Act § 22 & § 28; digital reproduction anchored via Cunningham 1892 public domain print plate.

modern.redistribution_permissions: Commercial and non-commercial sharing and adaptation permitted under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution
